description: The woman wears an opaque dark blue wool gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Tan-gold geometric embroidered borders outline the neckline, shoulder straps, cuffs and floor-length skirt hem. Round bronze clasps sit near the shoulders and waist. A red, cream and blue patterned woven belt has a long fringed front end. A blue-gray wool wrap rests around both forearms and hangs down the sides with tan-gold borders and fringe. A cream underdress shows between front panels. Dark brown leather shoes are visible below the hem, and her braided head remains uncovered.
